name: Skylar
description:
100% Brazilian Remy human hair with a medium brown base color, Level 6 root, and dimensional Level 7 to 8 highlights and lowlights for a gorgeous blended finish.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
